name: moco-mcp
description: MCP server for moco — editorial React components. Lets Claude (or any MCP client) browse, search, and install moco components into your project.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const h=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('registry/registry.json')).homepage; if(!/^https:/.test(h)) throw new Error('Registry built for '+h+' — rebuild with REGISTRY_URL=<prod url> pnpm build:registry before publishing')"

author: Shreya Agarwal (https://github.com/shreya0204)
